plan.text:
Add three focused JUnit regression tests to PricingCalculatorTest that pin down the existing bulk-discount threshold (subtotal >= 10,000 cents triggers a 10% discount per DiscountPolicy) at the boundary values 9,999, 10,000, and 10,001 cents. No production code (DiscountPolicy, PricingCalculator, etc.) will be changed. Tests will follow the existing conventions in the file (single-item Order via List.of(new Item(...)), @Test methods with descriptive camelCase names, assertEquals against calculator.calculateTotalCents(...)), then the pricing test suite will be run to confirm they pass.

Implementation steps:
1. Confirm current threshold logic in /src/main/java/com/sweforge/pricing/DiscountPolicy.java: no discount below 10,000 cents subtotal, 10% discount at/above 10,000 cents (for REGULAR tier).
2. Edit /src/test/java/com/sweforge/pricing/PricingCalculatorTest.java to add three new @Test methods, following the existing style used by smallRegularOrderHasNoDiscount and largeRegularOrderGetsBulkDiscount: (1) justBelowThresholdHasNoDiscount - Order with a single Item(9_999) expecting total 9_999 (no discount); (2) atThresholdGetsBulkDiscount - Order with a single Item(10_000) expecting total 9_000 (10% off: 10_000*0.90=9_000); (3) justAboveThresholdGetsBulkDiscount - Order with a single Item(1
3. Leave all production code files (DiscountPolicy.java, PricingCalculator.java, Order.java, Item.java, CustomerTier.java) untouched.
4. Run the relevant tests: mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test (or equivalent Maven test command scoped to this class) under Java 21, per repository conventions.
5. Optionally run the full suite with mvn test to ensure no unrelated regressions, per the pricing-build-validation skill guidance.

Validation:
- New test class compiles and all three new boundary tests (9,999 / 10,000 / 10,001 cents) pass.
- Existing tests (smallRegularOrderHasNoDiscount, largeRegularOrderGetsBulkDiscount, vipOrderGetsVipDiscount) continue to pass unchanged.
- Diff shows changes only in the test file; no production source files modified.
- mvn test (full run) completes successfully with no failures.
